classtree.jaymoskingdoms.monk_stun.desc: With no arrow coming, the class key readies a stunning blow: the next blow of the fist spends a ki and stuns what it strikes. A boss shrugs it off until its resistances are spent.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.monk_deflect.de: Hands free, an arrow you don't catch glances off for half. Hold sneak as you catch one and it goes straight back at whoever loosed it.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.monk_flurry.des: Sneak and the class key, with no caught arrow to throw, readies a flurry: the next blow of the fist spends a ki, and two quick blows follow it.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.monk_wind.desc: The class key in the air spends a ki on a long leap or a dash the way you look. Falling beside a wall, you slide down it unharmed.
Your flurry's blows shove the foe away, and the last knocks it off its feet.
A blow that would take you below half health spends a ki and hardens you: half harm for 5 seconds.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.monk_still.desc: Fear and charms fall off you, and meditating brings a ki back every 10 seconds.
A stunning blow sets the palm in what it strikes, for a ki more. Within two minutes the class key ends it: the foe falls. A boss, or another player, takes a heavy blow instead.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.monk_empty.desc: Sneak and the class key in the air spends two ki: for 5 seconds you go unseen, foes lose you, and every blow slips past.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.pal_wells.desc: Your hands heal 6 health more a day, and you smite once more a day, each rank.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.pal_smite.desc: Sneak and the class key readies a smite: the next blow of a weapon spends one and hits much harder, twice that against the dead. Back after a night's sleep.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.pal_shield.desc: Sneak and the class key on a friend: a ward, paid with 4 from your hands' pool, soaks up to 4 harm from each of the next 3 blows on them, for a minute.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.pal_aura.desc: You and friends within 10 blocks save better, and you know no fear.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.pal_oath.desc: Mercy, Spare the Fallen: a foe you bring down instead of killing heals you. Justice, Judgment: one known for a crime, or a raider, takes half again from your smites. Honour, Challenge: the class key on a foe calls it out; for 30 seconds it fights only you, and your blows on it hit harder.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.pal_sense.desc: The class key with no harm to mend: the undead and fiends within 32 blocks glow for you through the walls for 5 seconds. Every 20 seconds.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.pal_courage.des: Friends within your aura know no fear.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.pal_warding.des: Friends within your aura take 30% less from spells.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.pal_vigil.desc: A prayer at a shrine by night fills your smites and your hands, and until the next sunset your smites, your hands and your aura are half again as strong.
message.jaymoskingdoms.monk.palm: The palm is set. The class key ends it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.paladin.sense: You sense %s of the dead and the damned.
message.jaymoskingdoms.paladin.vigil: Your vigil is kept. You stand stronger until sunset.
